instruction: U-shaped kindergarten IFC model. Create a single-storey U-shaped kindergarten from scratch in Revit around an open play yard and export it to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc using the IFC4 schema. The IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, one IfcBuildingStorey, seven IfcSpace objects, eight IfcWall elements, one IfcSlab, and one IfcRoof. Name the spaces so they include Lobby, Classroom A, Classroom B, Nap, Dining, Teacher, and Toilet. Include at least three IfcDoor elements and eight IfcWindow elements. Do not include IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcStair, IfcColumn, or IfcBeam entities. Size the shaped model so it spans 26.0-30.0 m in X, 22.0-26.0 m in Y, and 3.0-4.2 m in Z. Express the U-shaped plan in the slab geometry: the slab's horizontal projected footprint should occupy 68%-82% of the full bounding-box rectangle, leaving the open yard implied by the missing portion. Other classroom sizes and finishes may vary, but all IfcRoot GlobalIds must be unique. [Software] Launch Revit with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`.
